name: Notice to Board of Employee Transfers and Reassignments
description: Notice of subsequent assignments involving a building transfer, a move to a position requiring different certification or credentials, or a change in organizational authority.
quote: The Superintendent or designee will notify the Board when subsequent assignments involve a transfer from one building to another or involve a move to a position requiring a certificate; or other credentials other than those required for the employee's present position; or change in organizational authority.
